name: How does financing affect apartment construction decisions?

mainEntity.name: Why do loan terms, interest rates, and draw schedules matter in apartment development?
mainEntity.text: Why do loan terms, interest rates, and draw schedules matter in apartment development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financing is one of the most important but least visible parts of apartment construction. Loan terms affect how much the project can spend, how long it can wait for permits, and how much cash the owner must keep available during construction. Interest carry and draw schedules can materially change total development cost, especially if the project is delayed by approvals or redesigns. This is why a project with a good construction budget can still fail financially. Lenders often require reserves, contingencies, and documentation of the permit path before funding progresses. Owners should make sure the financing plan matches the actual schedule, not an optimistic one. The longer the approval process or the more complex the site, the more important it is to understand carrying costs early. Construction and financing decisions should be evaluated together, not separately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing affects how much a project can afford to spend, how quickly it must move, and how much delay it can tolerate. Interest carry, draw timing, and lender reserve requirements can materially change whether an apartment project is feasible in Los Angeles.
